modules.title: Online Consistent k-Median with Outliers
modules.expensive_path: _best_swap: an O(|S| * |F \ S|) exhaustive 1-swap search over all (out, in) facility pairs, called from _run_local_search inside every add_point, so cost grows with the facility set on each arrival.
modules.rationale: Single self-contained file implementing one complete algorithm (Algorithm 1 of the paper) with its own input contract (facilities, distance function, k, z, gamma, eps) and output contract (current median set, recourse count, approximate cost). Whole-codebase default: there is only one scientific unit here, so paths is the full source root.
excluded: No separate unit tests exist to exclude; only the single demo example is available as official coverage.
hazards: No upstream repository or reference output: this is a self-authored, faithful simplification of the paper's algorithm, not a vendored third-party codebase.
Thin official-test surface: exactly one example script (the __main__ block), no isolated unit tests of internal routines (cost_p, _best_swap, _num_outliers).
Demo uses random.seed(0) for reproducible synthetic input generation only; the algorithm itself is fully deterministic given fixed inputs (no internal randomness).
modules.purpose: Single self-contained file implementing one complete algorithm (Algorithm 1 of the paper) with its own input contract (facilities, distance function, k, z, gamma, eps) and output contract (current median set, recourse count, approximate cost). Whole-codebase default: there is only one scientific unit here, so paths is the full source root.
primary_inputs: k: int, number of medians to maintain
gamma, eps: float tuning parameters (Theorem 5, Lemma 6)
stream of client point ids via add_point(j)
primary_outputs: current_solution(): list of current median facility ids
approx_cost(): float, unpenalized k-median-with-outliers cost of current S
algorithm_stages: online per-point update driving the above (add_point)
unique_responsibilities: maintains a size-k median set online under sequential point arrivals
bounds the outlier count via a doubling penalty parameter p
tracks total recourse (facility swaps) incurred across the stream
not_responsible_for: No separate unit tests exist to exclude; only the single demo example is available as official coverage.
